data.method: Download hash; contact sheet every 8 frames; continuity measurement against establishing tail; assembly after R51 context; frame counts; context tail audio correlation; uniform-frame scan; join frames 3299/3300 and hard cut 3447/3448.
data.scope: Shot A handshake source 0-147 at master 335.625-341.791667; hard cut; shot B v2 walk frames 112-143 at 341.791667-343.125; context 3480 frames.
data.limitations: Handshake performance: seated hold to ~2.5 s, look up, reach from ~3.3 s, hands meet ~4.5 s (source 108, master ~340.13 on 'two things'), held through 'He discounts it,' and the cut; nobody stands. Prepending establishing frames to land the grip exactly on 'He' was rejected: provider output differs in tone from the accepted source (mean 2.3/255 vs 0.35 normal step), which would pop. Context tail audio 0.99997 at zero lag; no uniform frames. Shot B keeps its slight rightward drift. Comprehension and continuity at the hard cut await owner review.
